results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.generatedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

results.question: 我们有多少个产品？
results.generatedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products;

results.question: List all loyalty tiers and how many customers are in each.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY loyalty_tier
ORDER BY loyalty_tier;

results.question: 有多少订单被退货了？
results.generatedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned';

results.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
平均订单金额是多少？
results.generatedSql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders;

results.question: What is the highest single order total?
results.generatedSql:
SELECT total_amount AS highest_order_total
FROM orders
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 每个忠诚度等级的客户平均下了多少订单？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.loyalty_tier,
       AVG(o.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
) o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier
ORDER BY avg_orders_per_customer DESC;

results.question: Top 5 products by total revenue.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.question: 每个产品类别的总销售额是多少？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

results.question: Which region has the highest total sales?
results.generatedSql:
SELECT r.region_name,
       SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 下单金额最高的 10 位客户是谁？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name, c.email, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email
ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.question: Show the monthly sales trend for 2025.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month;

results.question: 2026 年每个季度的订单数量是多少？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date)
ORDER BY quarter;

results.question: How many new customers signed up each month in 2025?
results.generatedSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers
WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND signup_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)
ORDER BY month;

results.question: 对比 2025 年和 2026 年的总销售额。
results.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS sales_year,
       SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)
ORDER BY sales_year;

results.question: Which product category has the highest return rate?
results.reviewNote: Return rate is ambiguous without specifying orders, line items, or units. Retained as a diagnostic case only.
results.generatedSql:
WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT p.category_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS returned_qty,
         SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.category_id
)
SELECT c.category_name,
       co.returned_qty,
       co.total_qty,
       ROUND(co.returned_qty * 100.0 / co.total_qty, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM category_stats co
JOIN categories c ON co.category_id = c.category_id
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 哪个品牌的利润率最高？利润 = 售价 - 成本。
results.generatedSql:
SELECT p.brand,
       SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS total_cost,
       (SUM(oi.line_total) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost)) / SUM(oi.line_total) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the average number of items per order?
results.reviewNote: Items is ambiguous between line-item rows and summed unit quantity. Retained as a diagnostic case only.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_items;

results.question: Platinum 等级客户贡献了多少比例的总销售额？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.loyalty_tier = 'Platinum' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(o.total_amount), 0), 2) AS platinum_share_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

results.question: How many countries are represented in the customer table?

results.question: 按名称字母顺序列出所有产品类别。
results.generatedSql: SELECT category_name FROM categories ORDER BY category_name;

results.question: How many orders were cancelled?
results.generatedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

results.question: 订单表里有多少种不同的状态？

results.question: What is the lowest product list price?
results.generatedSql:

FROM products
ORDER BY base_price ASC
LIMIT 1;

results.generatedSql: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM products WHERE rating IS NOT NULL;

results.question: How many units were sold across all line items?

results.question: 订单明细的平均折扣百分比是多少？
results.generatedSql:

FROM order_items;

results.question: Show the top 3 brands by line-item revenue.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT p.brand,
       SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

results.question: 每个客户所在国家产生了多少订单？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

results.question: What is completed-order revenue by sales region?
results.generatedSql:
SELECT r.region_name,
       SUM(o.total_amount) AS completed_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY completed_revenue DESC;

results.question: 每个产品类别有多少个产品？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

results.question: Which customer placed the most orders? Return their first name, last name, and order count.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 退货订单中，每个产品共退回了多少件？只显示前 5 名。
results.generatedSql:
SELECT p.product_name,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS returned_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'returned'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY returned_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.question: Show daily order counts for January 2026.

FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-02-01'

results.question: 最早一笔订单是哪一天？

results.question: What is the date of the latest order?

results.question: 分别统计 2025 年和 2026 年的订单数量。

       COUNT(*) AS order_count

results.question: Show average order value by month for 2025.
results.generatedSql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)

results.question: 哪个销售区域的退货订单率最高？
results.generatedSql:
WITH region_stats AS (
  SELECT r.region_name,
         COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'returned') AS returned_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  GROUP BY r.region_name
)
SELECT region_name,
       ROUND(returned_orders::numeric / total_orders * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM region_stats
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Which category generated the most gross profit, using unit price minus product cost?
results.generatedSql:
SELECT c.category_name,
       SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 有多少客户从未下过订单？
How many products have never appeared in an order item?

FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (

    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id

results.question: 有多少客户下过至少两笔订单？
results.generatedSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
